design_parameters.enrich_notes: SDDOT/DANR construction ESC and SWPPP course material tied to the South Dakota construction general permit. Excerpts cover erosion/sediment BMPs, SWPPP, inspection, dewatering (53 mg/L TSS limit), and post-construction narrative (ponds, vegetated swales, onsite infiltration) without numeric SCM sizing, WQv depth, drawdown, or media dimensions.
